title: When paying MettleUp online cannot work, the owner is told to try again in a minute or check the internet
what: Two refusals that never clear on their own get words that say they will. If the gym owner has no phone saved, the payment company is never asked and the owner reads "The payment page could not be opened. Try again in a minute", so every retry fails the same way. If the gym server part for online paying is missing, the owner reads "Could not open the payment page. Check the internet and try again". Online paying is behind a switch today.
expected: Each refusal says the real reason and the next step: add the owner phone number, or pay by UPI or bank transfer below for now.
how_often: every try while the owner has no phone saved or the server part is missing
fix_line: Pass the real reason to the admin app and give it its own words with the UPI or bank transfer way out

evidence: data:about 25 user-facing strings in this area (sign-in pages, member pop-ups, staff browser alert title, gate reply), all English. The member app offers no Hinglish, so its pop-ups need none; the admin app offers Hinglish and its closed-app alerts stay English (existing finding reused). No Hindi words here, so no read-aloud list. No banned-word list was given, none checked. "Ask Claude" on the not-set-up page is seen only by the owner.
data:every refusal code the HQ server sends was searched in the HQ page words; all but the payment-company-only codes have their own words
data:the sign-in pages use a 420 px column with 16 px padding, no nowrap and no fixed width; pop-up lines are cut by length and the phone wraps them
data:the server only serves the HQ icons (the v2 files exist in apps/hq/public/icons); their look is judged in the hq/app area. Member pop-ups are data-only, so the phone app draws its own icon

data:kinds posted from this area: gym message to /shop/inbox, offer to /shop, trainer or gym reply to /shop/ask, member notes with the route the gym server gives (/shop, /shop/message, /shop/orders, /shop/diet, /measures), team reply to /settings/feedback, staff browser alerts with the gym server route; every page exists in the app and the tap handler opens any app path

items.reason: this area is server code with no screens or save buttons; HQ save buttons are in the hq/app area
